title: Find the First Matching Record
prerequisite: Comfort reading and writing a TypeScript loop.
hints: Scan from index 0 upward and compare each value directly with the target; unsorted input gives no safe way to skip an unchecked index.
At index i, every earlier index has already been checked and does not match. That fact proves a match at i is the first match.
Return i immediately when values[i] equals target. If the loop finishes without a match, return -1.
